question: Was stellen die blauen Balken im unteren Bereich der Grafik dar?
question_english: What do the blue bars in the lower area of the chart represent?
model_answer: The blue bars at the bottom of the graph represent the trade balance (exports minus imports), measured in Mrd. US-Dollar. It shows that the trade balance was largely negative (below zero) from 2020 to 2023, becoming positive toward the end of 2023. This indicates a shift from a trade deficit to a trade surplus.
